evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that the v0.2 checkpoint of SmolLM-360M-Instruct beats its v0.1 predecessor in 63.3% of AlpacaEval comparisons.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only a single AlpacaEval comparison and no design, training-data, or evaluation details for this checkpoint, so model transparency is limited.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not document the training or tuning dataset for SmolLM-360M-Instruct, so data transparency is limited.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card states only text-in/text-out and open weights without specifying intended use or deployment context, leaving downstream risk scope undefined.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight checkpoint with no training-data provenance or retrieval mechanism, so outputs cannot be traced to training content.

specifications.model_size: 0.7 GiB of safetensors weights (723,674,912 bytes) in BF16
